info.title: DeskBoy Data Access API
info.description: Read-only access to your booking data, for programmatic/polling use.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Data Access API key, created in Settings → Data access (API) (Bearer deskboy_data_...). Each operation lists the scope the key needs.

id.description: Event id (evt_…). The same event always has the same id, also when it is sent again — use it to skip duplicates

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 — when the change happened, not when it was sent

externalBookingId.description: The booking id at the booking provider

externalReservationId.description: The reservation code at the channel

channel.description: Channel name as the provider reports it — open set

guestCountry.description: The guest's country, as the booking provider reports it or as given at online check-in — usually ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from the country code of the guest's phone number — not their nationality; it can differ from guestCountry

amountBreakdown.description: The booking's amounts from the booking provider; on a split part, prorated to its nights. Keys ending in Cents are in cents. Not every booking has every key.

manuallyCorrected.description: Amount or departure corrected by hand — the corrected values are shown

parentId.description: The booking this part was split from; null on the original

divided.description: This row was split into parts — no document is issued on it

split.description: Stays across a year boundary or a climate-fee rate change are split. The original booking stays in the list with split.divided = true and still carries the full amount; its parts follow as their own rows with split.parentId. To sum amounts or follow documents, skip rows where split.divided is true. To count stays, count rows where split is null or split.parentId is null

status.description:
- needs_setup: the property's invoicing settings need completing in DeskBoy
- ready: the accommodation document has not been issued yet — also for cancelled, historical and future bookings
- issued: all documents were issued
- issued_with_errors: the accommodation document was issued; the payment receipt or the climate resilience fee receipt failed
- partially_issued: not all of the booking's documents were issued — usually the accommodation document is still a draft
- failed: issuing failed before the accommodation document was issued — see failedAt
- split: the stay was split; documents are issued on its parts (see split)
- awaiting_mydata: the accommodation document was issued; the climate resilience fee receipt follows once myDATA registers it
- needs_review: held for review — the booking in DeskBoy shows why
- issued_externally: the accommodation document was issued outside DeskBoy, so it is not in /documents
- unknown: a newer status not listed here
